purpose: Non-admission discovery of six additional global CAT research source products covering roads, river flow, satellite water extent, disaster damage and flood exposure; no rights clearance, sample acquisition or model-input approval.

entries.name: NASA OPERA DSWx-HLS V1 dynamic surface-water classification
entries.spatial_scope: Near global; latitude 84 degrees north to 84 degrees south; actual tiles depend on imagery acquisition and quality
entries.temporal_scope: Collection states 2016 to present; validated water-extent observations begin April 2023
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 30 m Level-3 UTM tiles; 10 cloud-optimized GeoTIFF layers per granule including water class, confidence, cloud and terrain masks
entries.note: Fixed collection OPERA_L3_DSWX-HLS_V1, DOI 10.5067/OPDSW-PL3V1, CMR C2617126679-POCLOUD. HLS optical product is NOT the OPERA DSWx-S1 SAR product currently proposed in PR 1133. Water classification is not automatically inundation, depth, probability or insured loss. Preserve sensing time, tile, input-platform lineage, cloud mask, confidence flags, baseline permanent water and exact granule identity. Check Copernicus DEM and Sentinel terms and NASA distribution rights before any persistent acquisition. No live sample has been fetched in this work.

entries.name: GRIP4 Global Roads Inventory Project vector roads and density
entries.provider: PBL Netherlands Environmental Assessment Agency / GLOBIO
entries.spatial_scope: Global regionalized road inventory with nonuniform original mapping coverage
entries.temporal_scope: Meijer et al. 2018 publication; historical compilation; no claim of current 2026 completeness
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Regional ESRI Shapefile or File Geodatabase line networks; global 5 arcminute density rasters; regional archives range from tens of MB to GB
entries.note: PBL GRIP4 download page and original Zenodo publication state CC0, but GLOBIO's official Resources page states CC BY 4.0 and data.overheid.nl marks a SHAPE download CC BY 4.0 despite a CC0 dataset header; one third-party GIS republisher cites ODbL. Rights status therefore remains conflicting / unreviewed for exact assets and upstream OSM-derived contributions; do not automate commercial downloads or distribute GRIP4 bytes until authoritative scope is reconciled. The PBL portal exposes seven regional ZIPs (vector Shapefile and FGDB) plus global five-arcminute road-density rasters. Zenodo 6420961 publishes GRIP4_density_total.zip MD5 24d3ed5c079f7a898fbc4a5d68be337a: do not assume the PBL mirror has identical bytes; record exact publisher, URL, file name, timestamp, size and fresh SHA-256. This is historical road geometry/density, not present-day insured asset value. Road classes, source vintage, topology, data overlap and asset valuations require separate validation.

entries.name: GEOGLOWS River Forecast System V2 retrospective discharge and forecast ensembles
entries.spatial_scope: Worldwide modeled stream network, subject to basin coverage and model domain
entries.temporal_scope: Retrospective daily or hourly simulations from January 1940; daily 15-day forecasts; living dataset release and snapshot required
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Around 7 million river reaches; hydrography GeoPackage, discharge time series Zarr; river_id / LINKNO reach key
entries.note: RFS V2 training data catalogue labels the model CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, but the AWS Registry page for GEOGLOWS V2 labels the dataset CC BY 4.0. This rights conflict must be resolved with the authoritative data controller for exact Zarr assets before any commercial use, derived redistribution, or automated persistent acquisition. Simulated discharge in m3/s is not flood depth or extent; network ids differ from other basin networks. Preserve release date, forecast issuance, ensemble member, run period, forcing and reach geometry; compare GloFAS shared inputs before scoring independence.

entries.name: OECD river flooding exposure indicators DSD_ECH@RIV_FLOOD 2.0
entries.provider: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
entries.spatial_scope: Global at national level; subnational TL2 for OECD members and a selected additional set of countries
entries.temporal_scope: Indicator reference years around 2000 to 2020 depending on series; OECD portal last updated 12 October 2026
entries.resolution_or_granularity: SDMX time-series observations of land, population, cropland and built-up area exposed to 10-, 20-, 50- or 100-year river floods
entries.note: Exact dataset identity is OECD.ENV.EPI / DSD_ECH@RIV_FLOOD version 2.0; check SDMX dimension and unit codes and series revisions. This is aggregated exposure indicator data derived partly from JRC river flood maps, GHSL population and land cover, not original flood event polygons, site-level buildings, insured losses or independent observed ground truth. Do not double-count JRC/GHSL overlap. Reuse/API rules and allowed derived publication are not yet reviewed.

entries.name: FLO1K global annual streamflow grids 1960-2015
entries.provider: PBL / Radboud University / Barbarossa and collaborators
entries.temporal_scope: 1960 to 2015 annual derived flow estimates; original 2018 paper
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 30 arcsecond approximately 1 km CF NetCDF-4 raster layers: yearly mean, maximum monthly mean and minimum monthly mean flows, m3/s
entries.note: Rights conflict: the PBL file portal expressly says noncommercial academic research only, but data.overheid.nl lists CC BY 4.0 and an individual Figshare record may list CC0. Do not infer a commercial licence from a mirror or a journal open-access article; obtain authoritative exact-file clarification before downloading for any commercial CAT workflow. Files are tens of GB at native resolution. This is ANN-modelled potential in-channel river discharge, NOT actual station observations, daily peak flow or flood depth; yearly maximum means max of monthly-mean flow, not instantaneous flood peak. Preserve network mapping and model training dependence.

entries.name: UNOSAT Ranongga Island building damage assessment after MAILA-26, product 4244
entries.spatial_scope: Ranongga Island, Western Province, Solomon Islands
entries.temporal_scope: Satellite image assessment as of 15 April 2026; map published 28 April 2026
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Event-specific building damage mapping with PDF, Shapefile and File Geodatabase publication options
entries.note: Product 4244 identifies approximately 320 damaged and 370 potentially damaged buildings after tropical cyclone MAILA-26, assessed primarily using Pleiades satellite imagery and auxiliary aerial images. This is preliminary remotely sensed classification, not field-verified damage, cost or insured claim. Product-level and underlying commercial imagery rights are unresolved; download button does not grant redistribution. Preserve product ID, event date, footprint geometry, class definition, image dates, uncertainty and attribution. Do not use model validation on buildings shared with training labels.
